## <a id="task-r-4"></a>R-4 · Authorization Decision

*[Authorize](../../MANUAL.md#step-r) step · system level · primary phase [EMD](#ph-emd) · required · at least 1 stakeholder interview*

**Purpose.** Decide whether the risk is acceptable.

**Stakeholders (RACI)**

| Role | Persona |
|---|---|
| Responsible | [AO](../../personas/PER-AO.md) Authorizing Official |
| Accountable | [AO](../../personas/PER-AO.md) Authorizing Official |
| Informed | [PM/SO](../../personas/PER-PM.md) Program Manager / System Owner<br>[ISSM](../../personas/PER-ISSM.md) Information System Security Manager |

**Inputs**

| Input | What it is | Comes from |
|---|---|---|
| [ART-CAT](../../MANUAL.md#art-cat) | Security categorization | [C-2](PH-MSA.md#task-c-2) (core artifact) |

**Outputs**

| Output | What it is | This task | Package |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ART-AODM](../../MANUAL.md#art-aodm) | AO decision memo | produces | core |

**Entry criteria**

- Categorization approved.

**Exit criteria**

- decision.yaml names an AD-* decision.

**Authorization decision.** The [AO](../../MANUAL.md#per-ao) decides here: [ATO](../../MANUAL.md#ad-ato), [DATO](../../MANUAL.md#ad-dato) (see [authorization decisions](../../MANUAL.md#decisions)).

**Alignment**

- Milestones and decision points: [MS C](#ms-c)
- Authorization decisions: [ATO](../../MANUAL.md#ad-ato), [DATO](../../MANUAL.md#ad-dato)
